messages:
amanda: Heads up — saw a regression after the last gateway deploy. p95 host preproc CPU up ~12%, streaming start latency +60ms on some tenants. :eyes:
jia: which deploy shas? can you paste the canary id?
amanda: deploy-bot: canary 2026-03-12T03:12Z (commit d4f2b7). Repro by replaying a multi-chunk chat session (client v3+). Logs show spike during tokenization + parse step.
eli: ran a quick perf on a repro machine. hotspot is `tokenize_v2` and `parse_stream_frames`. kv cache miss rate also increased for long streams. snippet from perf report:
```
# perf samples (approx)
tokenize_v2     28.4%\nparse_stream    22.1%\nkv_lookup       11.3% (miss-driven)\nhttp_read       4.8%\nother           33.4%\n```
rohan: we did bump streaming chunk threshold in last week's tuning (PR #498). `max_chunk_bytes` was raised from 16384 -> 65536 to reduce RPCs for large inputs.
amanda: rollback to previous config on one canary reduced p95 back to baseline. so change looks causally related.
jia: hmm — why would larger chunk size increase tokenize/parse CPU? maybe more data per request means single-threaded tokenization sees worse cache behavior + kv entries span chunks and cause more misses.
rohan: also remember we switched to new batching heuristic that tries to coalesce small streaming frames into the same host-side batch if they arrive within 15ms. that interacts poorly with huge frames; it collapses chunk boundaries and forces reparse.
eli: experiment idea: limit `coalesce_window_ms` to 5ms for streams with `max_chunk_bytes >= 64k`, and add per-request kv-metadata to avoid cross-chunk kv lookups.
amanda: for immediate mitigation i've reverted the max_chunk_bytes on the gateway cluster and added a canary with the new heuristic disabled. p95 back to normal. need longer-term fix.
infra-bot: trace started — https://trace.int/redwood/trace/0c8f1a (linked to canary request sample).
rohan: action items: 1) instrument per-request kv hit/miss and per-chunk tokenize time (short-term). 2) add a guarded rollout: enable large chunk coalescing only for clients with `chunking_v2` header. 3) add perf test in CI that replays mixed-size streaming workload.
jia: I'll own (1) & (3) — will add metrics and a small replay harness. eli can you prototype the guarded heuristic change?
eli: on it. will prototype a patch to gate the coalesce behavior and add metrics to kv layer.
deploy-bot: rollback of config `gateway.max_chunk_bytes` -> 16384 applied to cluster-canary-7 at 1779999000. :white_check_mark:
amanda: thanks team. capturing notes in the perf runbook and filing a follow-up ticket (ENG-4712) for baking this into release checklist.
rohan: also let's add a small note in the console Observability page that streaming chunking config can impact host CPU — people expect larger chunks = cheaper but not always.
jia: will add a short blurb and a dashboard with `tokenize_time_per_chunk` and `kv_miss_rate_by_stream_size`.
amanda: cool — keep updates here. if anyone finds a quick micro-optim for tokenize_v2 (vectorized path or faster buffer parsing) ping this thread.
